stem: In a flower with 10 stamens in which nine filaments are fused into a bundle and one is free, the stamens are described as
solution:
Two bundles of fused filaments make a diadelphous condition (9 + 1 in pea). Monadelphous means one bundle (China rose), polyadelphous many (citrus) and syngenesious refers to fused anthers (sunflower).

stem:
**Assertion (A):** Removal of the shoot apex promotes the growth of lateral buds.

**Reason (R):** Auxin produced by the apical bud inhibits the growth of lateral buds.

Choose the correct option.
solution:

stem: The pressure-flow (mass flow) hypothesis explains the translocation of food in phloem as flow from
solution:
Sugar loaded at a source raises osmotic water entry and turgor in the sieve tube; at the sink unloading lowers turgor, so the sap flows from source to sink.
